#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

long long mod_pow(long long base, long long exp, long long modulus) {
    long long result = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % modulus;
        base = (base * base) % modulus;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    long long p, k;
    while (cin >> p >> k) {
        if (k == 0) {
            cout << mod_pow(p, p - 1, 1000000007) << endl;
            continue;
        }
        if (k == 1) {
            cout << mod_pow(p, p, 1000000007) << endl;
            continue;
        }
        long long sum = 0, tmp = 1, next = -1;
        do {
            next = (k * tmp) % p;
            tmp = next;
            sum++;
        } while (next != 1);
        cout << mod_pow(p, (p - 1) / sum, 1000000007) << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
